review.summary: Varied green/yellow-green leaves, dark branching bark and brown root fibres remain clearly separated. Front/back/top views retain detailed leaf coverage with no broad texture smears or unwanted material regions.

issues.problem: Lighter yellow-green canopy and denser leaf coverage than the reference.

review.summary: Rounded broadleaf shrub crown, numerous distinct leaf surfaces, branching stems and exposed root tuft match the reference subject. Low frontal view confirms the stems remain connected beneath the canopy; no planter or ground slab has been introduced.

issues.problem: Canopy is slightly fuller and conceals more of the branching stems than the reference.
Fine roots are delicate and should be checked for sensible simplification after reduction.
